content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps. The investigation relies almost entirely on HR Supervisor's denials and explanations, with no coworker or third-party witnesses for the yelling in front of others, the \"off the street\" remark, or the threats (claim 2 has no evidence at all). No comparator evidence appears on training, workload, or discipline beyond her assertion that other Assistants were treated alike, and no comparators or decision-maker rationale address the termination. Claim 9 has a direct conflict: Complainant says she requested equipment and got no response, while the supervisor says she knew nothing of it, yet she also said she sent Complainant to Employee Labor Relations and knew of the ergonomic assessment. That conflict is not resolved. The Georgia Vocational Rehabilitation Agency and Employee Labor Relations were not interviewed, and no emails or written requests were gathered. The medical documentation is from 2005 and says nothing about current restrictions. There is no probationary performance documentation or comparator evidence on probationers to test whether the termination reason was pretext. The record also offers nothing on the age, color, and religion bases. The final decision's finding of no discriminatory motive cannot be evaluated from this record."}
